Owed (core/materials/PROMPTS-NEEDED.md section 43): the beaten-gold roof sheet and the prayer-wheel copper with mantra relief. The city's ground (2026-11-11, the owner: 'the ground is blindingly textureless'): qGrass (ground.grass.lush, the Af country), qDirt (ground.dirt, the blocks' made ground), qCobble (paving.cobblestone_01, the lay streets), qFlag (paving.flagstone, the avenues and the kora); keep 1: the sets' own colours, the city's ground shader blends them by a zone mask (settlements/qiblai/targets/city/90q-qc-world.js).
